title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-q3hb: SCHC fragmentation_vectors test calls Fragment::from_bytes with 2 args but API changed to 1 arg
description: `lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs` at lines 241 and 379 calls `Fragment::from_bytes(&wire, &mut tile)` with 2 arguments, but the function signature changed to take only 1 argument: `pub fn from_bytes(data: &[u8])`. The test file was not updated to match the new API. This is a compilation failure that blocks the SCHC test suite.
